cd work && cat > stereo.py << 'EOF'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Chem.EnumerateStereoisomers import EnumerateStereoisomers, StereoEnumerationOptions

sml = "[NH]1C5C2(c6ccccc16)CCN3C2C(CC)(CCC3)CC5"
mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(sml)

opts = StereoEnumerationOptions(onlyUnassigned=True, unique=True)
isomers = list(EnumerateStereoisomers(mol, options=opts))
print("n stereoisomers:", len(isomers))

# drawing coords (image pixels), convert to right-handed: y -> -y
draw = {
 0:(255,415), 1:(370,383), 2:(370,265), 3:(260,227), 4:(212,115), 5:(92,100),
 6:(17,200), 7:(70,307), 8:(188,323), 9:(292,140), 10:(365,45), 11:(475,85),
 12:(475,205), 13:(585,260), 16:(690,205), 17:(690,75), 18:(583,25),
 19:(585,380), 20:(480,445),
}
idxs = sorted(draw.keys())
P = np.array([[draw[i][0], -draw[i][1], 0.0] for i in idxs], float)
P -= P.mean(0)

def transform(mob):
    # mob: (n,3) to align onto P (both centered outside)
    mc = mob - mob.mean(0)
    H = mc.T @ P
    U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(H)
    d = np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T @ U.T))
    R = Vt.T @ np.diag([1,1,d]) @ U.T
    return R

results=[]
for i,iso in enumerate(isomers):
    best=None
    for seed in range(12):
        m = Chem.AddHs(iso)
        ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed = 4321+seed; ps.useRandomCoords = (seed>=6)
        ok = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, ps)
        if ok!=0: continue
        try:
            mp = AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
            AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=1500)
            e = AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m, mp).CalcEnergy()
        except Exception:
            continue
        pos = m.GetConformer().GetPositions()
        if best is None or e<best[0]:
            best=(e,pos.copy(),Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
    if best is None:
        print(i, "embed failed"); continue
    e,pos,isosmiles = best
    heavy = pos[:mol.GetNumAtoms()]
    mob = heavy[idxs]
    mc = mob - mob.mean(0)
    R = transform(mob)
    al = mc @ R.T
    rmsd = float(np.sqrt(((al-P)**2).sum(1).mean()))
    allpos = (pos - mob.mean(0)) @ R.T
    # H on atom1 (A), H on atom12 (B), ethyl carbon 14
    hA = [n.GetIdx() for n in m.GetAtomWithIdx(1).GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='H'][0]
    hB = [n.GetIdx() for n in m.GetAtomWithIdx(12).GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='H'][0]
    zA, zB, zE = allpos[hA][2], allpos[hB][2], allpos[14][2]
    match = (zA<0) and (zB>0) and (zE>0)
    results.append((i,rmsd,zA,zB,zE,e,match,isosmiles))
    print(f"iso{i:2d} rmsd={rmsd:6.1f} zA(H@1)={zA:6.2f} zB(H@12)={zB:6.2f} zE(14)={zE:6.2f} E={e:7.1f} match={match}")

good=[r for r in results if r[6]]
print("\nMatching isomers (zA<0, zB>0, zE>0):")
for r in sorted(good,key=lambda x:x[1]):
    print(r[0], f"rmsd={r[1]:.1f}", f"E={r[5]:.1f}", r[7])
EOF

import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Chem.EnumerateStereoisomers import EnumerateStereoisomers, StereoEnumerationOptions

sml = "[NH]1C5C2(c6ccccc16)CCN3C2C(CC)(CCC3)CC5"
mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(sml)
opts = StereoEnumerationOptions(onlyUnassigned=True, unique=True)
isomers = list(EnumerateStereoisomers(mol, options=opts))

draw = {
 0:(255,415), 1:(370,383), 2:(370,265), 3:(260,227), 4:(212,115), 5:(92,100),
 6:(17,200), 7:(70,307), 8:(188,323), 9:(292,140), 10:(365,45), 11:(475,85),
 12:(475,205), 13:(585,260), 16:(690,205), 17:(690,75), 18:(583,25),
 19:(585,380), 20:(480,445),
}
idxs = sorted(draw.keys())
P = np.array([[draw[i][0], -draw[i][1], 0.0] for i in idxs], float)
P -= P.mean(0)

def scaled_kabsch(mob, ref):
    mc = mob - mob.mean(0); rc = ref - ref.mean(0)
    H = mc.T @ rc
    U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(H)
    d = np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T @ U.T))
    R = Vt.T @ np.diag([1,1,d]) @ U.T
    s = (S*np.array([1,1,d])).sum() / (mc**2).sum()
    return R, s

def hidx(m, i):
    return [n.GetIdx() for n in m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='H'][0]

for i in (1,3):
    iso = isomers[i]
    # CIP assignment
    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(iso, force=True, cleanIt=True)
    cip = {a.GetIdx(): a.GetProp('_CIPCode') for a in iso.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp('_CIPCode')}
    m = Chem.AddHs(iso)
    ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed = 99
    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, ps)
    mp = AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=2000)
    e = AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m, mp).CalcEnergy()
    pos = m.GetConformer().GetPositions()
    heavy = pos[:mol.GetNumAtoms()]
    mob = heavy[idxs]
    R,s = scaled_kabsch(mob, P)
    mc = mob - mob.mean(0)
    al = s*(mc @ R.T)
    rmsd = float(np.sqrt(((al-P)**2).sum(1).mean()))
    allpos = s*((pos - mob.mean(0)) @ R.T)
    zA, zB, zE = allpos[hidx(m,1)][2], allpos[hidx(m,12)][2], allpos[14][2]
    print(f"iso{i}: CIP={cip} E={e:.1f} scaledRMSD={rmsd:.1f}px zA={zA:.2f} zB={zB:.2f} zE={zE:.2f}")
    # save aligned conformer for viewing
    conf = m.GetConformer()
    for k in range(m.GetNumAtoms()):
        conf.SetAtomPosition(k, allpos[k])
    Chem.MolToXYZFile(m, f"iso{i}_aligned.xyz")
    Chem.MolToMolFile(m, f"iso{i}_aligned.mol")
EOF

import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem

ref = Chem.MolFromSmiles("[NH]1C5C2(c6ccccc16)CCN3C2C(CC)(CCC3)CC5")
m = Chem.MolFromXYZFile("mmff.xyz")  # no stereo, just coords; use for geometry
mh = Chem.MolFromSmiles("CC[C@@]12CCCN3CC[C@]4(c5ccccc5N[C@@H]4CC1)[C@H]32")
# map mh atom order -> ref atom order
match = mh.GetSubstructMatch(ref)
print("match:", match)
# match[i] = index in ref corresponding to mh index i

draw = {0:(255,415),1:(370,383),2:(370,265),3:(260,227),4:(212,115),5:(92,100),
 6:(17,200),7:(70,307),8:(188,323),9:(292,140),10:(365,45),11:(475,85),
 12:(475,205),13:(585,260),16:(690,205),17:(690,75),18:(583,25),19:(585,380),20:(480,445)}

# read xyz
lines = open("mmff.xyz").read().splitlines()
n = int(lines[0]); pos=[]
for ln in lines[2:2+n]:
    f=ln.split(); pos.append([float(f[1]),float(f[2]),float(f[3])])
pos=np.array(pos)
heavy = pos[:mh.GetNumAtoms()]

# reference-order heavy coords
reforder = np.zeros_like(heavy)
for i,ri in enumerate(match):
    reforder[ri] = heavy[i]
idxs = sorted(draw.keys())
P = np.array([[draw[i][0],-draw[i][1],0.] for i in idxs]); P-=P.mean(0)
mob = reforder[idxs]; mc = mob-mob.mean(0)
H = mc.T @ P; U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(H)
d = np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); R = Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T
s = (S*np.array([1,1,d])).sum()/(mc**2).sum()
al = s*(mc@R.T); rmsd = np.sqrt(((al-P)**2).sum(1).mean())
allpos = s*((pos - mob.mean(0))@R.T)

# probe atoms in mh numbering: find via ref indices
# A=ref1, B=ref12, E1=ref14; map ref->mh
inv = {ri:i for i,ri in enumerate(match)}
A,B,E1 = inv[1], inv[12], inv[14]
mm = Chem.AddHs(mh)
# H attached to A and B in mm (same heavy order)
hA=[n.GetIdx() for n in mm.GetAtomWithIdx(A).GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='H'][0]
hB=[n.GetIdx() for n in mm.GetAtomWithIdx(B).GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='H'][0]
print(f"rmsd={rmsd:.1f}px  zA={allpos[hA][2]:.1f} (want<0)  zB={allpos[hB][2]:.1f} (want>0)  zEt={allpos[E1][2]:.1f} (want>0)")

 6:(17,200),7:(70,307),8:(188,323),9:(292,140),10:(365,45),11:(475,85),
 12:(475,205),13:(585,260),16:(690,205),17:(690,75),18:(583,25),19:(585,380),20:(480,445)}

R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T
s=(S*np.array([1,1,d])).sum()/(mc**2).sum()
allpos=s*((pos-mob.mean(0))@R.T)

hB=[x.GetIdx() for x in mm.GetAtomWithIdx(B).GetNeighbors() if x.GetSymbol()=='H'][0]
print(f"xTB check: zA={allpos[hA][2]:.1f} (want<0)  zB={allpos[hB][2]:.1f} (want>0)  zEt={allpos[E1][2]:.1f} (want>0)")

# stereocenter chirality check via signed volumes (compare with MMFF structure)
def chirality_sign(pos, mh):
    # CIP priority order neighbors for each center in ref numbering
    # A(ref1): N(ref0) > Q(ref2) > D2(ref20) > H
    # Q(ref2): B(ref12) > A(ref1) > C3a(ref3) > P1(ref9)
    # B(ref12): N4(ref11) > Q(ref2) > Cc(ref13) > H
    # Cc(ref13): B(ref12) > D1(ref19) > R3(ref16) > E1(ref14)
    heavy = pos[:mh.GetNumAtoms()]
    out={}
    # get H indices
    mm=Chem.AddHs(mh)
    def h(i):
        return [x.GetIdx() for x in mm.GetAtomWithIdx(inv[i]).GetNeighbors() if x.GetSymbol()=='H'][0]
    def sv(c, n1, n2, n3, n4):
        # signed volume of n1,n2,n3 seen from c with n4 as lowest (positive -> R if priority n1>n2>n3 and n4 away?)
        r1,r2,r3,r4 = pos[n1],pos[n2],pos[n3],pos[n4]
        return np.linalg.det(np.stack([r1-r4, r2-r4, r3-r4]))
    # use determinant with lowest priority as origin; sign tells R/S: if det>0 then 1->2->3 is... we'll just compare MMFF vs xTB
    tests = {
      'A': (inv[1], inv[0], inv[2], inv[20], h(1)),
      'Q': (inv[2], inv[12], inv[1], inv[3], inv[9]),
      'B': (inv[12], inv[11], inv[2], inv[13], h(12)),
      'Cc': (inv[13], inv[12], inv[19], inv[16], inv[14]),
    }
    for k,(c,a,b,cc,dd) in tests.items():
        out[k]=np.linalg.det(np.stack([pos[a]-pos[dd], pos[b]-pos[dd], pos[cc]-pos[dd]]))
    return out

print("xtb chirality signed-volumes:", {k:round(v,2) for k,v in chirality_sign(pos,mh).items()})
lines2=open("mmff.xyz").read().splitlines()
pos2=np.array([[float(x) for x in ln.split()[1:4]] for ln in lines2[2:2+int(lines2[0])]])
